evidence:
Scope: source/prompt QC for row 25 only. Opened the actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx with openpyxl, inspecting Quality Checks row 26 (check 25), Internal Quality Checks row 26, and related Deterministic Checks row 28. The public row requires every dimension to use the live browser rather than source, memory or first paint; the Internal row repeats that interpretation without imposing a different requirement. Applied frozen Harbor SKILL.md, quality-checks.md:108-110, staged-task-contract.md:113-158, deterministic-checks.md:44,50-54, and current qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md. All 18 relevant task/rule files checked against manifest hashes matched.

All five actual prompt files were read, including the full 460-line Functional prompt, both gate criteria, Polish/Visual criteria, and shared app_context. Each judge.toml resolves prompt_template = "prompt.md" and declares the Playwright MCP server at lines 6-12. A read-only tomllib/placeholder resolution check found exactly one {app_context} and {criteria} in each prompt, confirmed the live localhost URL, Playwright instruction and implementation-source restriction in all five, and counted 1/1/64/7/6 criteria for Render/Constraints/Functional/Polish/Visual. tests/test.sh:198-200 substitutes the shared context into every */*/prompt.md; app_context.md:4 supplies the same localhost URL.

Concrete prompt evidence (all paths below are relative to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task): tests/gates/render/prompt.md:1-10 says to evaluate the live app using Playwright MCP, prohibits implementation files/scripts/bundles, and distinguishes entered snippet text from execution evidence. Its judge.toml:23-27 requires a new authored marker, pressing Run, and observing that marker in BOTH rendered preview and console; "a hardcoded sample is insufficient." tests/gates/constraints/prompt.md:1-11 likewise requires Playwright and prohibits implementation inspection; lines 15-33 demand a fresh independent browser context, observed controls/data and no guessed routes. Its judge.toml:25-29 requires a normal UI write, captured response, actual clean-context library load and reload; "A success toast, health response, static seed file or localStorage entry alone is not proof."

For scored dimensions, tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:1,5-15 directs Playwright, live reload, ordinary controls, actual UI values/markers/times, forbids implementation/source/database reads and says "Never invent a pass." Its plan at lines 104-113 requires every observation and reuses observed facts rather than verdicts. Examples of mandatory live work are S01:119-121 (select/edit/run/save/reload), S03:156-161 (click/key/input after idle, Stop and recovery), S15:358-361 (expand the real console object, expressly forbidding source-as-evidence), S23:421-426 (two dirty editors and real conflict recovery), and S34:442 (two actual theme changes). tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:1-9 directs Playwright and usability evidence from DOM/screenshots/interactions; lines 34-39 forbid unperformed-step credit; lines 43-49 require actual keyboard events, example selection, saved-snippet loading and observed focus, without programmatic focus. tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:1-9 directs Playwright and rendered screens only; lines 24-37 require live reload, desktop plus approximately 390x844 observations, at least two mobile surfaces, and both offered themes; lines 44-50 demand rendered evidence and forbid fabricated views. Therefore even Visual cannot be satisfied by a single first-paint screenshot. app_context.md:26-28 distinguishes unavailable evaluator evidence from product failure and forbids inventing a pass.

Counterexample challenge, by source analysis: a conforming application using server-rendered library documents, an empty initial library, native/composite controls, a drawer library, and a different editor DOM is allowed. Constraints judge.toml:27 explicitly accepts server-rendered documents without a JSON/list endpoint; Functional prompt:11, Polish:43-47 and Visual:35-37 require purposes and observable surfaces rather than fixed selectors/packages or a prescribed layout. No row-25 false-fail witness was found. A broken static workspace displaying attractive sample code/output plus no-op Run/Save cannot satisfy Render's newly authored execution marker or Constraints' newly saved record in a clean context. A desktop-only screenshot cannot satisfy the scored live interaction, viewport and theme observations. No source/memory/first-paint escape was found.

This Pass establishes the instruction content and prompt wiring required by row 25. No full configured judge was run or supplied here; raw-evidence-index.json explicitly identifies scripted browser observations and no configured verifier/target/Oracle/judge-workload evidence. Judge compliance and runtime completion remain NOT EXERCISED, and no runtime score or overall QC clearance is claimed.
